thread.title: Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft MBH Cuts Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft MBH Cuts Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: meag munich ergo kapitalanlagegesellschaft mbh cuts holdings

text:
Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft MBH decreased its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 44.0% during the 2nd the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 253,620 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 199,005 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up 2.9% of Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft MBH’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft MBH’s holdings in Apple were worth $47,443,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
A number of other hedge funds and other also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Stelac Advisory Services LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 19.0% in the 4th quarter. Stelac Advisory Services LLC now owns 4,268 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $722,000 after purchasing an additional 680 shares during the last quarter. West Chester Capital Advisors Inc. bought a new position in Apple during the fourth quarter worth $2,633,000. Brown Advisory Securities LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 5.0% during the fourth quarter. Brown Advisory Securities LLC now owns 144,452 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $24,446,000 after acquiring an additional 6,877 shares in the last quarter. Mutual Advisors LLC bought a new position in Apple during the fourth quarter worth $6,762,000. Finally, Day & Ennis LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 14.0% during the fourth quarter. Day & Ennis LLC now owns 12,920 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,186,000 after acquiring an additional 1,590 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors own 58.58% of the company’s stock.
